newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine to liberalise hryvnia convertibility rules.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine to liberalise hryvnia convertibility rules.

text.p: Ukraine's central bank said on Monday it planned to liberalise rules for buying foreign exchange for the new hryvnia currency to help foreign trade.
"These changes would make our national currency freely convertible during business transactions," National Bank of Ukraine Chairman Viktor Yushchenko at a news conference.
One change would remove limits on the ability of non-residents with accounts at Ukrainian banks to convert hryvnia into another currency to pay for goods or services.
Interest would also be paid on foreign-held bank accounts, he said.

The central bank also plans to clarify rules on whether non-residents are allowed to purchase foreign currency on the Ukraine Interbank Currency Exchange. --Natalya Zinets, Kiev Newsroom +380 44 229 2264
